name: Kalasam Jaikrishna Industries
heroAlt: Kalasam Jaikrishna Industries chemical and camphor manufacturing export website
h1: Case Study: Scaling an International Export Presence for Kalasam Jaikrishna Industries
problem: A camphor and chemical manufacturer with legacy manufacturing roots dating back to 1995—and exporting goods to over 17 countries—had no authoritative digital presence to verify legitimacy and attract direct international institutional buyers.
solution: Engineered a high-performance corporate platform featuring an interactive product catalog with comprehensive laboratory specifications, dedicated inquiry pathways for OEM and export distributors, direct WhatsApp integration, and international technical SEO.
features: Dynamic product specification catalog with chemical purity grades
Dedicated multi-tier export, OEM, and bulk distributor inquiry flows
Sub-second load times engineered with lightweight semantic HTML and CSS
Automated WhatsApp lead dispatch allowing direct manufacturer communication
Structured data implementation allowing international B2B buyers to verify company credentials

testimonial.quote: For the past few days our company was facing low orders and few business connections. Once you launched our website, everything changed — we are now getting more export clients, distributors and enquiries.
testimonial.author: Executive Leadership

name: JKI Orders B2B Platform
tag: B2B Ordering Platform · Android APK · PWA
heroAlt: JKI Orders B2B distributor ordering platform Android app and progressive web application
h1: Case Study: Replacing Phone Call Orders with a Custom B2B Distributor Portal
problem: Wholesale distributors placed orders through manual phone calls and disorganized WhatsApp messages. This led to frequent dispatch tracking errors, delays in sending GST invoices, and difficult reconciliation of customer payment ledgers.
solution: Built a unified B2B digital ordering ecosystem: a friction-free customer portal, warehouse staff administrative back-office, a lightweight Android APK package, and an installable desktop Progressive Web App (PWA).
features: Simplified customer authentication using mobile number and secure 4-digit PIN
1-tap repeat order functionality based on past buying history
Real-time warehouse dispatch status tracking and transport LR number logging
Automated GST invoice generation and printable statement ledgers
Installable PWA and standalone Android APK for field operators

testimonial.quote: Thank you very much for this great work at such a fair price. Taking orders from our customers is now very easy for our company.
testimonial.author: Operations & Logistics Manager

name: Aparna Stores E-Commerce
heroAlt: Aparna Stores online grocery and supermarket e-commerce platform
h1: Case Study: Digitizing a Legacy Supermarket with Bulk Pricing & WhatsApp Orders
problem: A trusted Theni supermarket operating continuously since 1965 required an online shopping experience so local families and bulk institutional buyers could order groceries, household essentials, and bulk staples without waiting in checkout lines.
solution: Engineered a rapid mobile-first e-commerce web application featuring intuitive category browsing, live search, promotional discounts, tiered bulk-pack pricing, dynamic cart and checkout, and automated WhatsApp order dispatch.
features: Lightning-fast product search with instant category filters
Tiered bulk-pack discount pricing engine for volume buyers
Frictionless mobile cart, checkout, and order history tracking
Direct integration with local home delivery logistics via WhatsApp alerts
Lightweight architecture achieving 95+ mobile performance score

testimonial.quote: I didn't expect such a great result for such a small budget. I am very satisfied with the features and the price, and I will recommend your work to everyone I know.
testimonial.author: Store Management
